thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created — elevated 5xxs observed on model-inference-prod (route: /v1/generate). Alerting SRE oncall. auto-created incident ID INC-2026-045.

sre-anna: I'm on it, grabbing logs and checking pager. Can someone confirm impact? metrics show spike at 15:12 UTC.

mike-eng: seeing a lot of 5xx gateway errors from model-runner pods, repeated 'segfault' in stderr of runner container. Example from logs:

```
[2026-03-14T15:12:07Z] runtime: panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
goroutine 1423 [running]:
model/serve.(*Runner).Decode(0xc000...)
\nSIGSEGV: segmentation fault
```

runtime-ops: confirmed core dumps on 3/8 pods in the autoscaling group. Memory RSS spikes right before crash, looks like OOM pattern. gcore files exist in /var/crash.

sre-anna: ok, immediate mitigations? Priorities: reduce customer impact, prevent further crashes, collect artifacts.

eng-tom: suggest immediate rollback to last-known-good model variant (model-v2.3.1) which is smaller; also reduce per-pod concurrency to avoid full memory concurrency blowouts. Rollback safe and quick.

runtime-ops: starting scale-change and model rollback. Running:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/model-runner model-runner=registry/redwood/model-runner:stable-2026-02-10
kubectl -n inference patch deployment/model-runner -p '{"spec": {"template": {"spec": {"containers": [{"name": "model-runner","env": [{"name":"MAX_CONCURRENCY","value":"2"}]}]}}}}'
```

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Action logged: rollback + concurrency patch by runtime-ops.

cs-liz: flagging customers on SLA watchlist. Which customers saw errors? Need list to message.

sre-anna: pulling trace sample — high tail latencies and timeouts correlate to these 5xxs. For now, we're adding a route-level fallback to a CPU-based fallback endpoint for critical customers. Command to enable fallback: `redwoodctl routes set-fallback --route /v1/generate --fallback model-cpu-small --priority critical`

mike-eng: enabling fallback now. Also setting autoscaler lower bound to create more, smaller pods instead of fewer big ones: `hpa` min replicas 6 -> 12.

runtime-ops: rollout started. Not all pods finished redeploy yet. Attaching recent stack traces to this thread and uploading gcore to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-045/gcores/

sre-anna: monitoring grafana panels. Error rate dropping from 18% -> 6% after rollback and fallback — still above baseline. CPU fallback is serving some traffic for critical customers.

eng-tom: also turning on guarded mode in router to divert non-critical traffic to cheaper fallbacks and lower token limits: `routerctl set policy /v1/generate --tier default --limit-tokens 512 --fallback model-cpu-small`

cs-liz: notifying at-risk customers: AcmeCorp, Buildly, FinanceAI. Sending status update to accounts and creating incident status page.

oncall-bot: :hourglass_flowing_sand: Escalation threshold crossed — paging infra-lead.

runtime-ops: collecting heap profiles from the oldest crash pod; I'm running `gdb` to get backtraces and generating `pprof` traces. Attaching link: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-incidents/INC-2026-045/pprof/heap-2026-03-14-15-18.pb.gz

mike-eng: quick check — are we sure this is a model memory blowup and not a kernel-level driver issue? Any GPU OOM logs?

runtime-ops: no kernel oom; dmesg clean. GPU drivers report memory allocation failure before segfault on a couple hosts, but the pattern is per-process RSS climb likely from model runner codepath.

sre-anna: we should keep the rollback and fallback until we have a reproducible test. Will open a debug environment with same model and traffic replay. eng-tom, can you run replay with --mem-profiling?

eng-tom: starting traffic replay on staging-debug with identical batch sizes and sequence lengths. Command: `replayctl run --target staging-debug --profile mem --payload samples/large_sequences.json`

cs-liz: PR sent to status page and customer-facing note drafted. Need a short blurb for customers impacted with ETA for next update.

sre-anna: handoff — I'll be oncall for next 30m, then mike-eng will take over. mike, pls ack.

mike-eng: ack, i'll take over at 15:45 UTC. Please include runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-runtime-5xx

runtime-ops: debug env shows same OOM when we replay highest-token sequences; memory climbs until segfault. Looks like a regression introduced in the model tokenizer caching layer. Created a debug branch to revert tokenizer caching patch.

eng-tom: good catch. If revert fixes memory, we can release small patch to main and roll forward. Plan: verify in debug, then canary deploy to 2 pods in prod and monitor for 15m.

sre-anna: current customer impact: ~11% of requests experienced 5xx during peak; critical customers on CPU fallback seeing successful requests. Status page updated: "Mitigation in progress: rollback and fallbacks in place. Investigating root cause; next update in 30m."

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Handoff recorded: from sre-anna to mike-eng at 15:45 UTC.

mike-eng: taking lead. Repro confirmed in debug with reverted caching — memory stable. Preparing canary patch and will run canary against a subset of low-traffic cluster first. Will keep this thread updated.

cs-liz: customer update sent. One partner asked for timeline — told them tentative ETA 2-3 hours pending canary.

runtime-ops: uploaded tarball of artifacts and logs: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-045/artifacts.tar.gz. Including pod logs, gcores, pprof.

mike-eng: canary rolled out to 2 pods with reverted tokenizer cache. Monitoring: no segfaults in 10 minutes and error rate for canary traffic 0.2%. If stable for 15 more minutes, we'll roll to 50% then 100%.

sre-anna: excellent. Make sure to run post-deploy smoke and memory profilers. Also open postmortem ticket and assign owners.

mike-eng: will open PMT: INC-2026-045 postmortem and assign eng-tom (root cause), runtime-ops (artifacts), cs-liz (customer comms), and me (remediation rollout).

cs-liz: will follow up with customers after full roll.

oncall-bot: :tada: Incident status: mitigated (error rate returned to baseline) at 16:38 UTC. Incident WILL be moved to postmortem; incident channel archived when postmortem created.

sre-anna: thanks team. Key action items: 1) ship tokenizer cache revert and regression test, 2) postmortem with timeline and impact, 3) add mem-safety e2e to prevent regressions, 4) retention of artifacts.

eng-tom: noted, starting PR now.

mike-eng: closing loop here, will post postmortem link once created.

cs-liz: closing customer loop after full rollout and validation.
